question: Which of the following nations hosted the first Asian Games in 1951?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first Asian Games** was hosted by **India in 1951**.
 
• It is a continental multi-sports event **held every four years** among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The motto of the Asian Games is **'Ever Onward'**.
 
• ​The first Asian Games began on **March 4, 1951, in New Delhi**.
 
• It is also known as **'Asiad'.**
 
• It was regulated by the **Asian Games Federation from 1951 to 1978**.
 
• Since 1982, the **Olympic Council of Asia** now regulates the Asian Games.
